validate_file_quantizable_tensors: validate that each quantizable tensor in a safetensors file can be quantized with a given scheme
process_file_quantize_compress: quantize and compress tensors in a safetensors file using a standard quantization scheme
process_file_microscale_quantize: quantize and compress tensors using a microscale scheme like NVFP4 or MXFP4 with fused module support
split_fused_moe_experts: split fused MoE expert tensors from 3D tensors into individual 2D expert tensors
process_file_microscale_calibrate: calibrate global scale across fused modules and compress with shared microscale quantization parameters
